lead.headline: 0-5 after a 5.4-point loss; Golden goes in this week
lead.deck: Kings of the North won 131.84 to 126.44 while Golden scored 20.3 on your bench. Rice is questionable, Barkley 'hopeful', and Chicago have not named a quarterback for Loveland.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. You are 0-5. Week 5 went to Kings of the North, 131.84 to 126.44, and 22.3 points sat on your bench: Matthew Golden scored 20.3 while Carnell Tate, the projection's coin-flip choice, scored 1.6. Rashee Rice is questionable with a hamstring that has no practice report yet; Saquon Barkley is only 'hopeful'; and Colston Loveland does not know who will throw to him. This week the projection is not a coin flip: Golden 16.1 against Tate 11.9. Start Golden, put Rice in the flex if he is active at 12:55 Sunday with George Pickens as the fallback, and you face Los Cachanillas, projected 78.8 with their defence on bye.
